items.title: How “reverse game theory” could keep AI agents in check
items.pt: A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize them to stick to the rules. As AI models become more capable, safety researchers are scrambling to ensure they are “aligned” with human desires, to make sure, in other words, that rogue agents don’t break the law,…

items.title: We built a free ATS resume checker that runs entirely in the browser
items.pt:
Every placement season, students in India pay for "ATS score" tools or upload their resumes to sites they've never heard of, hoping for a magic number. Most of those tools score keyword density, which isn't how applicant tracking systems actually work.

We run Hirastra, a site that lists fresher IT jobs verified on 1,300+ companies' own careers pages. Our users kept asking "is my resume ATS-friendly?", so we rebuilt our checker from how real ATS software screens resumes. It's free, and the resum

items.title: Project manager LinkedIn About section examples you can adapt
items.pt:
LinkedIn's own help page says the About section "should express your mission, motivation, and skills," and suggests keeping it to one or two paragraphs. Project managers tend to fill those paragraphs with the job description. "Delivered projects on time and on budget" is what the role is for, so a hiring manager reading it learns nothing about you.

The fix is to write the section the way you'd write a status report for a sponsor who has no patience. Name the kind of project, say what was hard a

items.title: GEICO Files a 114-Worker WARN Notice in Lakeland, Florida, Effective December 31, 2026
items.pt:
GEICO Files a 114-Worker WARN Notice in Lakeland, Florida, Effective December 31, 2026


GEICO has filed a WARN notice covering 114 workers at its Lakeland, Florida site, with an effective date of December 31, 2026. The notice was published on November 2, 2026, making it the newest dated filing on Layoff Atlas's national homepage at the time of writing, and the largest fresh dated filing not previously covered by this series.

The filing lists the site as 3535 W Pipkin Road, Lakeland, FL 33811,

items.title: EgoActionBench: Benchmarking Dense Action Captioning for Egocentric Human Videos
items.pt: Learning from human data offers a scalable path toward embodied intelligence, yet it requires models to accurately understand fine-grained human actions from egocentric observations. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in action atomicity, temporal precision, and hand-action association. We introduce EgoActionBench, a benchmark that represents continuous human manipulation as temporally localized atomic actions associated with the left hand, right hand, or both hands. items.title: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
items.pt: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training.
